h1.en: What Diesel 30 Concrete Pump lists, with International System of Units as the illustration
h1.zh: 为什么柴油30型混凝土泵的外形尺寸不是泵送距离列出的内容，用「国际单位制」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Main-unit weight is is 2000 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。理论输送量是15 m³/h，最大出口压力是20 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units: SI Illustration Base Units and Constants Colour Full. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. The frame “Loader (equipment)” shows Wacker Neuson wheel loaders at a trade fair and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units页上的SI Illustration Base Units and Constants Colour Full。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 2000 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Subject: Wacker Neuson wheel loaders at a trade fair. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是15 m³/h，最大出口压力是20 MPa。主体：Wacker Neuson wheel 装载机s at a trade fair。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 2000 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below.
body.zh: 画面「Loader (equipment)」的主体是Wacker Neuson wheel 装载机s at a trade fair，不是这个型号的工地实测。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 15 m³/h. Main-unit weight is 2000 kg.
body.zh: 外形尺寸是4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 15 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_System_of_Units.
